This application has been filed on behalf of the Applicant under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail in case FIR No. 828/2022 dated 26.10.2022 under Sections 498A/304B IPC, registered at PS: Narela Industrial Area.

2. Learned APP states that 02 material witnesses are yet to be examined before the Trial Court and therefore release of the Applicant at this stage may prejudice the prosecution evidence as there are chances that he may influence or threaten the material witnesses.

3. Refuting the allegations made on behalf of the State and without adverting to the merits of the present application, learned counsel for the Applicant seeks to withdraw the present application with liberty to approach the Trial Court after the 02 material witnesses are examined.
